page.overview:
What is Sinistcha?

Unremarkable Form Sinistcha evolves from Counterfeit Form Poltchageist using an Unremarkable Teacup, while Masterpiece Form Sinistcha evolves from Artisan Form Poltchageist using a Masterpiece Teacup.

Sinistcha is an ecologically similar counterpart to Polteageist.

Sinistcha is a combination of "sinister" and "Matcha" (Japanese green tea).

Its Japanese name, Yabasocha, comes from yabai (dangerous) and socha (low grade tea, coarse tea).
